course_summary:
ISEN 661 | Network-Based Planning and Scheduling Systems | Fall 2026
Instructor: Sergiy Butenko | butenko@tamu.edu
Meets: TR | 09:35AM-10:50AM | ZACH 345
Grading: Lecture quizzes [10%], Homework assignments [15%], Exams [75%] — A: [90,100], B: [80,90), C: [70,80), D: [60,70), F: [0,60)
Topics: out-of-kilter algorithm, pure and generalized network specializations of the primal simplex method, multi-commodity networks, Minimum spanning tree problem, Maximum clique, independent sets, clique relaxations, NP- hard problems, network science, emerging research directions, mathematical modeling, network optimization theory, network optimization algorithms, algorithms of network flow models, Shortest paths, Maximum flows, Minimum-cost flows, Assignments, matchings, networks, graph theory basics, design and analysis of algorithms, Fundamental theory
Prerequisites: ISEN 620 or 622
